subject: Lift proven mesh idempotency into EffectKernel/Restate crash recovery

body.objective: Use a real owned effect to prove Restate/EffectKernel/ProtocolMachine semantics instead of another mock workflow.
required_actions: Use the already-safe run8-mesh export as the first real idempotent external effect. Derive the effect key from bound WorkGraph obligation + immutable event/content identity.
Route the effect through the registered Restate/EffectKernel path where available and inject crash points before send, after remote write/before receipt, and after receipt/before local completion.
On replay, require exact remote readback and zero duplicate semantic effects. A pre-existing identical event is success-by-idempotence; different bytes at the same identity remain terminal collision.
Bind AgentSession/WorkerRun/ProtocolMachine lifecycle to the same effect receipt so process restart cannot create a second logical operation.
Do not use Blogger publication as the crash fixture while OAuth remains an interactive authority block.
body.acceptance: Three crash/replay positions converge to one remote semantic effect and one completion frontier, with explicit receipts for retries and no last-writer-wins behavior.
